reason: Promote to active. The uncertainty in the 2026-09-28 review was only about Copilot's past non-enforcement, which had been inferred from GA wording. Official evidence on disk shows the mechanism, enforcement lagging per product surface, is current. GitHub's content-exclusion docs still state that IDE Copilot Chat agent mode is unsupported. The Copilot app and CLI gained exclusions only at GA on 2026-09-02/04. Claude Code v2.1.253 fixed project settings that could enable raw API body logging without proper controls. Two vendors and official documents support it, with no conflicting evidence. RMD-SURFACEPARITY-001 (official, treat new surfaces as ungoverned until tested, managed-settings precedence) is current. These mitigations are scoped to particular surfaces and do not make the global problem inactive.

evidence.summary: Content exclusion docs still state IDE Copilot Chat agent mode is unsupported, so the per-surface lag is ongoing.
Copilot app and CLI now honor content exclusions (GA 2026-09-02).
v2.1.253: fixed project settings enabling detailed tracing or raw API body logging without proper controls.
official/known-applicable; allowlist new surfaces only after a live exclusion/telemetry test; enforce via managed settings.

model_assessment.assessment: Product governance mechanism that does not depend on the model.

remedy_assessment.assessment: Official maturity, current. Pin versions at or above the GA and fix releases.
